title: Law and Tradition
summary: The distinction between God’s law and human tradition is important in many Gospel conflicts.
background: Jewish leaders often debated how to apply the law in daily life. Jesus confronted traditions when they displaced the command of God or hid the weightier matters of mercy, justice, faithfulness, and love.
teachingHelp: When teaching these passages, avoid anti-Jewish caricature. Focus on Jesus’ concern: God’s Word must not be overridden by religious tradition.
